data: Is the relative IC accuracy of the 'Multi-task Model [10]' lower than the accuracy of the 'Model in [9] - Unfreeze all layers' when the average entropy is 8?

The caption states that the relative intent classification accuracy increases as the average entropy decreases. The question asks about the relative IC accuracy of two models at an average entropy of 8. From the figure, we can see that the 'Multi-task Model [10]' (purple line) has a lower relative IC accuracy compared to the 'Model in [9] - Unfreeze all layers' (blue line) at this point. Therefore, the relative IC accuracy of the 'Multi-task Model [10]' is indeed lower than the accuracy of the 'Model in [9] - Unfreeze all layers' when the average entropy is 8.
